title: Boone County Planning Unit — legislative-body adoption authority map

jurisdictionBasis.finding: The adopted Article 34 text expressly distinguishes Unincorporated Boone County, City of Union, City of Walton, and City of Florence in sign provisions. Jurisdiction-specific legislative adoption evidence is therefore required before a future rewrite is treated as effective across the whole Planning Unit.

verifiedRecordPaths.florence: Official city government page exposes Council Meeting Agendas & Minutes and City Ordinances; business/special minutes are posted after City Council approval.
verifiedRecordPaths.union: Official Commission Meetings page exposes 2026 meeting agendas and approved meeting minutes; official records are retained at City Building.
verifiedRecordPaths.walton: Official city pages expose 2026 City Council agendas/minutes and a Current Ordinances archive. The ordinance archive demonstrates that Boone County Planning Commission zoning recommendations are adopted by Walton ordinance.

authorityBoundary: Boone Fiscal Court action alone must not be generalized to Florence, Union, or Walton. A comprehensive rewrite should remain jurisdiction-pending unless official legislative action/effective-date evidence is verified for the applicable jurisdiction. This map identifies authoritative record channels; it does not claim that any of the four legislative bodies has adopted the 2026 comprehensive rewrite.
adoptedSignAuthority: Continue using the separately archived adopted Article 34 jurisdiction-specific provisions until newer reviewed official legislative action and effectiveness evidence establishes replacement text for the applicable jurisdiction.
nextLogicalAuthorityTarget: Inspect Florence City Council 2026 agendas/minutes and ordinance records for any comprehensive zoning-rewrite adoption item, then repeat the same bounded adoption check for Union and Walton.
